payload.text: ST0008 review fixes from vc on 5bf482a/3add4f8 (one or two commits, both bashes via intent-vc slot booked through vc): MUST 1 brew restart keys on keg version/path not commit (revision bump), with test; 2 molt_install_drift dirs from _molt_runtime_pathspecs; 3 --force only when managed_by is molt, refuse other manifests by name; 4 local-bin links only when missing or broken, else refuse naming what is there, never replace a file (install.bats local-bin tests). SHOULD 5 checked restore mv naming $stage.old; 6 resolve prefix parent with pwd -P for the in-dev-tree guard, refuse --prefix /; 7 chmod 755 stage; 8 dirty check keeps git stderr apart; 9 HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 for dry-run outdated; 10 one commit-of-tree function; 11 formula.bats isolates git config (HOME or GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL)
